name: Samantha
source:
Samantha Smith in Sovyonok. Welcome to an alternative story of [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url]!

No, the camp hasn't been overrun by zombies, a cruise liner hasn't crashed into the dining hall, and Viola hasn't stopped being a vampire. It seems everyone is in their place: Semyon, Olga Dmitrievna, Samantha...
Samantha?!
And it's true: the first American pioneer girl is here, right next to Semyon, sometimes even closer than he would like. All that is left to do is to become friends with her, because even the most famous girl in the world sometimes needs help and care.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=354397869]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《苏芙乔诺克的萨曼莎》是[url=/v3126]《永恒之夏》[/url]的另类故事！

不，夏令营没有被丧尸占领，邮轮没有撞进食堂，维奥拉也没有停止当吸血鬼。一切似乎都各就各位：谢苗、奥尔加·德米特里耶芙娜、萨曼莎……

萨曼莎？！

没错：第一个美国先驱少女就在谢苗身边，有时甚至比他希望的距离更近。现在只需要和她成为朋友，因为即使是世界上最著名的女孩，有时也需要帮助与关心。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=354397869]Steam[/url]]
